environment.accelerator: CPU (XGBoost and scikit-learn do not use the Apple GPU/MPS here)

deployment_label: Benchmark only. Not used by Finora and not the deployed anomaly model's accuracy.

datasets.name: Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB Machine Learning Group / Worldline)
datasets.licence: Public (OpenML licence field); Database Contents License on the original Kaggle release
datasets.labels: confirmed fraud flags from the card processor
datasets.acquisition_note: The official OpenML ARFF (https://openml.org/data/v1/download/1673544/creditcard.arff, MD5 178bcf9bb1f31a3dfe12d0e577884add) could not be downloaded: the server drops the connection after a few minutes and does not support resuming (byte ranges ignored); three attempts failed. The same data was taken from Google's public mirror (used by the TensorFlow imbalanced-data tutorial).
datasets.verification: Mirror file MD5 matches the mirror's published hash. Content checked against the OFFICIAL OpenML ARFF: the first 32,017 data rows (the complete rows of the official download before it was cut off, ~11% of the data) are identical value for value in all 31 columns, with the same column order. Totals match the published dataset: 284,807 rows, 492 frauds. The remaining rows could not be compared with the official file.

limitations: Features are anonymised PCA components; results do not transfer to Finora's per-person features.
